summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Call & Quotation Tracking feature for Sharda Lead Management Dashboard. All backend APIs are working correctly, frontend UI components are properly implemented, and integration between frontend and backend is functional.

minor_issues.issue: Export endpoints return binary data but test expects JSON response
minor_issues.impact: Test parsing issue only - functionality works correctly

passed_tests: Backend API - GET /api/kpis returns all Call & Quotation metrics (calls_placed: 3, quotations_sent: 2, call_to_quotation_rate: 66.67%, not_called: 3407)
Backend API - GET /api/leads/dropdown-options includes all 6 call status options
Backend API - POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/call-remark successfully adds call remarks with timestamp and user tracking
Backend API - GET /api/leads/{lead_id}/call-remarks returns call remarks history
Backend API - PUT /api/leads/{lead_id} successfully updates call_status, quotation_sent, quotation_date fields
Frontend Dashboard - All 4 Call & Quotation KPI cards visible and showing correct values
Frontend Edit Lead Modal - Call & Quotation Tracking section present with Call Status dropdown, Quotation Sent toggle, and Quotation Date field
Frontend Lead Details - Call Status and Quotation badges appear in lead details panel
Frontend Call Remarks - Add Call Remark button opens modal with textarea and remarks history
Call to Quotation Rate calculation logic verified as correct (66.67% = 2/3 * 100)

success_percentage.backend: 95% (1 minor parsing issue with binary export endpoints)
